## Discrepancies

### DISC-1: TC-22 expects 16 in-scope files; the correct count is 17 (now 18 after CR-01) [High] — **CLOSED**

- **FSD said** (§10.1, TC-22 at v1.0/v1.1): *"Change scope is minimal — `git diff --stat` — Only the **16 in-scope files** (plus matrix/worktree if applicable); no dependency/business code."*
- **Actual codebase / TDD**: the correct change was **17 artefacts** — the §1.2 TA note already reconciled this (*"`package-lock.json` must be added … making the realistic diff **17 files**"*; §13.6.3 was titled *"The commit allow-list (17 artifacts)"*), but **TC-22 (§10.1) was not included in that supersession list**, nor was §3.6 (*"the file list must match §2.2 (16 files, ± matrix/worktree)"*).
- **Impact when open**: a QA agent executing TC-22 verbatim would mark a **correct** implementation as failed, or a DEV eager to satisfy TC-22 would drop `package-lock.json` from the commit and ship a tree whose lockfile disagrees with both manifests.
- **Resolution — FSD v1.2.** TC-22 (§10.1) and the scope check in §3.6.2 step 10 now assert **17 artifacts**, an explicit normative supersession notice was added (§1.2), and §13.6.3 is the authoritative enumeration.
- **Resolution — FSD v1.3 (CR-01).** TC-22 now carries the full oracle: **18 entries = 17 modified + 1 deleted** (`.github/workflows/build-native.yml`, FR-14), with `auto-release.yml` and `scheduled-prebuild-scan.yml` noted as modified *in-set* (§12.3 rows 19–21). §3.6.2 step 10 carries the same "+ CR-01 deletion" clause.
- **Residual**: none. TDD v1.1 uses **18** consistently (AD-1, AD-11, MF-03, FV-14, §4.2.7, §13 steps 11–12).

### DISC-2: Dockerfile CVE comment attributed to lines 33–36, but the comment block is 33–34 [Low] — **CLOSED**

- **FSD said** (§4.1, row "Reproducibility/CVE comment", v1.0/v1.1): *"`backend/Dockerfile` (lines **33–36** after edit)"*.
- **Actual file**: L31 is the section-header comment, **L32** is `ARG NODE_VERSION=22`, **L33–L34** are the two-line base-image comment, **L35** is `ARG NODE_BASE_DIGEST=…`, L36 is blank. The editable comment block is **L33–L34** within the editable region **L32–L35**.
- **Impact when open**: cosmetic only — a DEV following the old text might append a line at L36 or shift the block. The comment's *content* is what BR-13 requires.
- **Resolution — FSD v1.2.** The §1.2 scope table (row 6) now names the comment block as **lines 33–34**, and §4.1 carries a "Dockerfile line-number convention" note stating the verified positions (L31 header comment, L32 `ARG NODE_VERSION`, L33–L34 comment block, L35 `ARG NODE_BASE_DIGEST`).
- **Residual**: none. The TDD still avoids line numbers as an edit contract (**AD-10 — anchor by key, never by line number**), which is why this class of discrepancy cannot recur here.

### DISC-3: `.nvmrc` validation regex permitted a missing trailing newline; the TDD requires exactly 8 bytes [Low] — **CLOSED**

- **FSD said** (§4.1, row "Local runtime pin", v1.0/v1.1): validation `^22\.23\.4\n?$` — the trailing `\n` was **optional**, i.e. a 7-byte file passed.
- **TDD says** (§4.2.3, FV-04, §13 step 4): exactly **8 bytes** — `32 32 2E 32 33 2E 34 0A` (`22.23.4` + one LF). A missing trailing newline causes some POSIX tools to mis-read the last value; CRLF (9 bytes) is a known nvm-windows failure mode.
- **Impact when open**: the two documents disagreed on what "correct" means, so EV-07 could be argued either way in review.
- **Resolution — FSD v1.2.** The content contract is now stated in §3.3.4 (Data Specifications) and in the §4.1 row "Local runtime pin", both as: exactly `22.23.4\n`, **regex `^22\.23\.4\n$`**, **8 bytes**, byte sequence `32 32 2E 32 33 2E 34 0A`, no BOM, no CRLF.
- **Residual**: none. FV-04 asserts the byte contract directly.

### DISC-4: `build-native.yml` builds `better-sqlite3` prebuilds for a package that is not a dependency [Low] — **CLOSED (disposition changed by CR-01)**

- **BRD / FSD said** (BRD R-03, FSD §13 SCC-01): the native modules to verify in the image are `onnxruntime-node` and `rolldown`.
- **Actual repository**: `better-sqlite3` is declared by **no** `package.json`, is **absent from `node_modules`**, and appears in `package-lock.json` exactly **once**, as metadata-only optional-peer text inherited from `knex@^3.3.0` (`peerDependenciesMeta["better-sqlite3"].optional = true`, L11620) with **0 resolved packages**. Meanwhile `build-native.yml` (167 lines) compiles `better-sqlite3@<input>` in a throwaway `build-temp/` directory and publishes `better-sqlite3-v…-node-v22-…` assets.
- **Impact when open**: a QA agent reading R-03 might try to `require('better-sqlite3')` inside the image, fail, and raise a **false regression** against this ticket.
- **Resolution — FSD v1.2.** §13 SCC-01 scope note and §3.6 scope note record that the probe is limited to **`onnxruntime-node`** (a transitive dependency: `backend → @huggingface/transformers@4.3.1 → onnxruntime-node@1.30.0`), and that `better-sqlite3`'s absence says nothing about the runtime.
- **Resolution — FSD v1.3 (CR-01).** The v1.0 recommendation ("defer to a separate DevOps cleanup ticket") is **superseded**: the removal is now in scope as **FR-14** (delete the workflow), **FR-15** (drop its `auto-release.yml` trigger item), **FR-16** (strip its material from `scheduled-prebuild-scan.yml`), gated by **AC-08** (`grep -rn "build-native\|better-sqlite3\|BETTER_SQLITE3" .github/workflows/` must be empty) and **BR-29/BR-30**. The TDD records this as **AD-11**; `AD-5` (matrix preservation) now applies to `build-onnxruntime.yml` only.
- **Residual**: none in this repository. The external publication of `better-sqlite3` prebuilds still happens somewhere else — recorded as **OI-T-14** in the TDD (ownership of that pipeline is outside this repository; nothing here may be relaxed on its behalf).
